Part 1 slows a difficult moment down so you can identify the situation, emotion, automatic thought, and initial response.

## Thought Record Part 1 {#thought-record-part-1}

### 1. Situation

**Who, what, when, and where?** Describe the event briefly and factually.

### 2. Emotions, Mood, and Sensations

Name each emotion or sensation and rate its intensity from 0 to 100. Possibilities on the worksheet include sadness, fear, anger, shame, guilt, and anxiety; use your own words when another emotion fits better.

### 3. Automatic Thoughts

Write the words or images that went through your mind. Identify the **hot thought**—the thought most strongly connected with the difficult emotion—and rate how much you believe it from 0 to 100.

Do not challenge the thought yet. Part 1 is for slowing down and recording what actually happened in your mind and body.
